gap: MX2 open point 1: a large streamed GeoJSON of keyed polygons with unkeyed pins or lines refused with STREAMED_MAPPING_COVERAGE, because the streamed profile counted each field over every accepted feature
rule: As MX2 on the streamed path: an outline kind (building, parcel, public_land) keys only the features it draws, those whose geometry.type is not Point, MultiPoint, LineString or MultiLineString. Their pins and lines are counted aside as GEOMETRY_KIND, and their keys are neither required nor reserved. A road or utility layout still keys every feature. An outline with a missing or null key refuses with the existing words; a repeated or empty one is still held by the mapped worker (DUPLICATE_SOURCE_KEY, MAPPING_IDENTITY_INVALID).

trace.contract: StreamedProfilePathSchema gains optional outline:{types,values,explicitNull,absent,integers}, the same counts over the drawn features, present only when the file holds both drawn features and pins or lines. Field order of the existing counts is unchanged.
trace.inventory: streamed-profile-inventory.ts counts every path over all accepted features and, through one count() helper, over the drawn ones; previousOutlines() recovers the drawn counts of a generation that published none (all outlines: its whole counts; only pins and lines: none), so the result does not depend on where chunks fall. The coverage invariant also holds over the drawn count.
trace.layout: streamed-mapping.ts layoutProfile adds outlineLiteralIdEligible and outlineIntegerIdEligible from outline counts (complete over the drawn total); registry.ts keyFacts (MX2, unchanged) reads them for an outline kind over a set-aside geometry type and falls back to the whole-file facts for a profile stored without outline counts.
trace.normalizer: chunk-mapping-normalizer.ts: after the source-shape check, a feature the plan's kind sets aside becomes an unresolved observation with GEOMETRY_KIND (plus any schema drift); its key is reported when valid text, never required or reserved; its name is not read. pairMappedFeatures unchanged: it drops such features even when observed and keyed.

decisions: Set-aside features are 'unresolved' with GEOMETRY_KIND, mirroring MX2's area.py rejection; a mixed large layout under an outline kind now ends completed_with_rejections where a keyed mixed file used to end completed. The officer words still come from intakeLargeSetAside and the reader's geometry summary.
Uniqueness is not counted in the bounded profile (as before); the mapped worker reserves keys, now over outlines only.
The profiler pin (streamedProfilerSha) changes with the contract and inventory files, as for any profiler change.

tests.writtenFirst: intake-large-geometry.test.ts: unkeyed pins/lines lay out for building and parcel, road refuses with the same words; integer keys over outlines; pins counted aside as GEOMETRY_KIND with keys reported but not reserved, a pin sharing an outline's key raises no conflict, and only outlines are cut; outline missing or null key refuses for building and road; outline counts identical for every chunk cut and a pins-first order, absent for single-kind files; an older profile without outline counts keeps the whole-file refusal; MX1 test now expects building dispositions observed/unresolved and confirms pairMappedFeatures drops set-aside features from observed, keyed records
